    print(u,v,round(8.27-dy,3))
cy2=sum(est)/len(est); print("cy =",round(cy2,3),"(DR 0.779)")

d0=2.592-cx
print("\ndark_table_1 west edge plane x at various heights:")
for z in (0.0,0.45,0.60,0.70,0.75,0.80):
    k=(1.55-z)/1.55
    print(" z=%.2f -> x=%.3f"%(z,cx+d0*k))
EOF
